source: FTA Decision No. 12 of 2026 · Domestic Minimum Top-up Tax
headline: TOP-UP TAX:
REGISTER BY

blocks.text: For UAE entities of multinational groups with a Fiscal Year ended **before 30 April 2026**.

items: **Revenue test:** EUR 750m+ in 2 of the last 4 years
Register **even if Top-up Tax is zero**
Decide which entity **files for the group**
